# inja (vendored)

`inja/inja.hpp` is the single header of [inja](https://github.com/pantor/inja)
v3.4.0, MIT, (c) 2018-2022 Lars Berscheid. The license text is kept inside the
header itself.

**What renders with it:** the e-mail templates (`src/email/Templates.hpp`).

**Why vendored instead of downloaded.** `CMakeLists.txt` used to fetch this
file from raw.githubusercontent.com at CONFIGURE time, so every clean build
depended on GitHub being reachable and not rate-limiting us. When GitHub
answers 429, sanitizer/tsan CI jobs stop configuring at all — the build fails
for a reason that has nothing to do with the code. Vendoring removes the
dependency outright.

**Do not edit this file.** CMake asserts its SHA256 against the expected sum
and fails configure on mismatch; the sum is the same one the download used to
verify, so the file is provably identical to upstream. Upgrading the version
means replacing the file together with the sum, not patching in place.
